items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: And Mr. Cobb loved me, and he should... I was the only man he ever gave a Christmas present to. He gave me a hundred dollars... He was a kind man, he was a fine man.

ctx.x: He insults me, gives me a can of metal polish. I said, well, I'll remember you, Mr. Miller, Mr. Arthur Miller. Just jealous, that's all. And everywhere I went, the bands were being depleted by the war, the best men were being tricked, drafted, and the leaders were taking jobs as bandmasters and all that stuff. It was a good thing they brought me along, because I was the one who would set the tempo, not the drummer, the strange drummer. I'd give them that, I'd play a waltz, I'd give them that, with the trumpet,…
